name: Chupa Chups Skate & Create🎨 [FREE UGC!]
desc:
Welcome to Chupa Chups Skate & Create 🍭🛹
Skate the city. Tag your world. Flex your flavor. Join the summer fun!

Complete quests, beat challenges, and earn new exclusive Chupa Chups items like lollipop back blings, bucket hats, skateboards, and more. Collect them all before they’re gone! 

🛹 Pick your ride – skateboard or roller skates – and grind across rooftops, rails, and ramps.
🎯 Complete quests to unlock UGC, creds, tricks, and limited-time stencils.
🖌️ Spray and play – tag graffiti across the city using collected cans.
💰 Deliver Chupa Chups to fans and earn bonus creds.
📸 Festival area with photobooth, scavenger hunt, and summer vibes.
🏁 Challenge friends in races, stunt runs, and timed missions.
🏆 Climb the leaderboards to show who's really skating the city.
